name: native-c-compiler
description: The native C compiler driver native-c-compiler.mjs and its Jet twin NativeCCompiler.jet in Tools/packaging (#5072 c9): run $CC (default cc) with the caller's arguments followed by the flags of Compiler/JetCli/Source/Cli/native-c-policy.tsv, give the child NIX_HARDENING_ENABLE without the policy's removed features (split on whitespace, single-space joined) and JET_NATIVE_C_WRAPPER_ACTIVE=1, and exit as the child exits, re-raising the signal that stopped it. A run that already has JET_NATIVE_C_WRAPPER_ACTIVE=1 stops with exit 2 before it starts a compiler, and a CC that cannot start fails with exit 1. The fixture's fake-cc prints each argument and the two variables, and exits with FAKE_CC_EXIT or stops itself with FAKE_CC_SIGNAL. Every case sets NIX_HARDENING_ENABLE, so the machine's own value leaks into nothing.
